release.name: NetBank 1.0
release.desc: First release of the retail net-banking portal: secure login, accounts overview, statements, fund transfer, beneficiaries, bill payment and alerts.

sprints.name: NetBank Sprint 1
sprints.goal: Customers can log in securely and see their accounts.

sprints.name: NetBank Sprint 2
sprints.goal: Account details, mini statement, own-account transfer, and adding beneficiaries.

sprints.name: NetBank Sprint 3
sprints.goal: Loan details, statements by date, IMPS transfer, daily limit, and debit alerts.

requirements.text: The portal shall authenticate a customer with customer ID, password, and a 6-digit one-time password (OTP) sent to the registered mobile number. The OTP shall expire after 3 minutes.
requirements.rationale: RBI guidelines require additional factor authentication for internet banking.

requirements.text: The portal shall end a session after 5 minutes without user activity and warn the customer 60 seconds before.
requirements.rationale: An unattended session on a shared computer exposes the account.

requirements.text: The portal shall lock net-banking access for 24 hours after 3 consecutive failed password attempts and notify the customer by SMS.
The portal shall show every Savings, Current, and Personal loan account of the customer with the available balance as held in the core banking system.
requirements.rationale: The overview is the landing page after login.

requirements.text: The portal shall show transactions for any date range within the last 12 months, newest first, with running balance.
requirements.rationale: Customers need statements for tax returns and loan applications.

requirements.text: The portal shall generate a statement as PDF, protected with a password made of the first 4 letters of the name and the date of birth (DDMM).
requirements.rationale: A downloaded statement must not be readable by others.

requirements.text: The portal shall transfer funds between accounts of the same customer instantly, without OTP, 24 hours a day.
requirements.rationale: Low risk: the money stays with the customer.

requirements.text: The portal shall send IMPS transfers to a registered beneficiary 24 hours a day, up to INR 5,00,000 per transaction, after OTP confirmation.
requirements.rationale: IMPS per-transaction limit set by NPCI.

requirements.text: The portal shall send NEFT transfers of any amount and RTGS transfers of INR 2,00,000 or more to a registered beneficiary, after OTP confirmation.
requirements.rationale: RTGS minimum amount set by RBI.

requirements.text: The portal shall reject a third-party transfer that would take the total of the day above the customer limit (default INR 10,00,000).
requirements.rationale: Caps the loss if credentials are stolen.

requirements.text: After a beneficiary is added, the portal shall allow at most INR 50,000 in total to that beneficiary during the first 24 hours.
requirements.rationale: Limits fraud with newly added beneficiaries.

requirements.text: The portal shall send an SMS and an e-mail within 60 seconds of every debit, with amount, account (last 4 digits), and available balance.

epics.goal: Customers log in safely and the bank meets RBI authentication rules.
epics.measure: Login success rate at least 98 %; zero account takeovers.

epics.goal: Customers see all their accounts and balances on one page.
epics.measure: 80 % of logins open the overview without a branch call.

epics.goal: Customers get statements without visiting a branch.
Customers move money to own and third-party accounts at any time.
epics.measure: 40 % of transfers made online within 6 months.
No fraud loss on beneficiaries added in the last 24 hours.

epics.goal: Customers pay bills and know about every debit.
epics.measure: Alerts delivered within 60 seconds for 99 % of debits.

hld.text: The UI calls the API gateway. The Auth service checks the password hash in the customer store, asks the OTP service to send an OTP through the SMS gateway, and issues a session token. The gateway checks the token on every call and ends idle sessions.
The Account service reads accounts and balances from the core banking system (CBS) through its adapter and caches them for 30 seconds.
The Statement service queries transactions from the CBS adapter, renders PDF files with a password, and a nightly job e-mails monthly statements.
The Transfer service checks the limit, asks for an OTP, posts the debit in CBS, and routes the credit: internally for own accounts, to the NPCI IMPS switch, or to the RBI NEFT/RTGS gateway.
The Beneficiary service validates the IFSC code, stores the payee, and keeps the 24-hour cooling cap that the Transfer service checks.
The Payment service fetches bills from the biller aggregator (BBPS) and pays them through the Transfer service. The Notification service listens to CBS debit events and sends SMS and e-mail.

stories.summary: Log in with customer ID and password
stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to log in with my customer ID and password, so that I can use net banking from home.

lld.text: Password hashes use bcrypt cost 12. The controller never says which of ID or password was wrong. A correct password creates a pre-session that is valid only for the OTP step.

scenarios.name: Valid password
scenarios.when: the customer submits the login form
scenarios.then: the OTP page opens

scenarios.name: Wrong password
scenarios.when: the customer submits the login form
scenarios.then: "Invalid customer ID or password" is shown and the failed count is 1

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to confirm my login with an OTP on my phone, so that nobody can log in with a stolen password.

lld.text: 6-digit OTP from a secure random generator, stored as a hash with its expiry. 3 wrong OTPs end the pre-session.

scenarios.name: OTP accepted
scenarios.given: an OTP was sent to the registered mobile
scenarios.when: the customer enters it within 3 minutes
scenarios.then: the accounts overview opens

scenarios.name: OTP expired
scenarios.then: "OTP expired" is shown with a Resend link

stories.summary: End the session after 5 idle minutes
stories.story: As a retail customer, I want my session to end when I walk away, so that nobody uses my account on a shared computer.

lld.text: The gateway stores last activity per token. The UI shows the warning at 4 minutes. Any API call resets the timer.

scenarios.name: Warning shown
scenarios.when: one more minute passes without activity
scenarios.then: a warning with "Stay logged in" appears

scenarios.name: Session ended
scenarios.then: the login page opens with "Your session has ended"

stories.story: As a bank security officer, I want access locked after 3 wrong passwords, so that nobody can guess passwords.

lld.text: failedCount and lockedUntil are columns of the customer table. Unlock happens automatically after 24 hours or at a branch.

scenarios.name: Lock after 3 failures
scenarios.when: the customer enters a wrong password again
scenarios.then: access is locked for 24 hours and an SMS is sent

scenarios.name: Counter reset
scenarios.then: the failed count is 0

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want all my accounts and balances on one page, so that I know how much money I have.

lld.text: Accounts are grouped by type: deposits first, loans last. Balances are cached 30 seconds.

scenarios.name: Three account types
scenarios.given: a customer with one Savings, one Current, and one Personal loan account
scenarios.then: 3 rows with type, number (last 4 digits), and balance are shown

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want interest rate, nominee, and branch of my Savings account, so that I can check my account data.

lld.text: Read-only view. The nominee name is masked except the first letter.

scenarios.name: Details shown
scenarios.then: interest rate, nominee, IFSC, and branch are shown

stories.story: As a business customer, I want my overdraft limit and used amount, so that I can plan payments.

lld.text: Available = balance + overdraft limit - used overdraft.

scenarios.name: Overdraft shown
scenarios.given: a Current account with an overdraft of INR 2,00,000
scenarios.then: limit, used amount, and available amount are shown

stories.story: As a loan customer, I want my EMI, outstanding amount, and next due date, so that I never miss an EMI.

lld.text: Remaining EMIs computed from the CBS schedule. Overdue EMIs shown in red.

scenarios.name: Loan shown
scenarios.given: a Personal loan with EMI INR 12,500
scenarios.then: EMI, outstanding, next due date, and remaining EMIs are shown

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want my last 10 transactions, so that I can check recent debits quickly.

lld.text: Calls the statement query with limit 10. No date range.

scenarios.name: Last 10
scenarios.when: the customer opens the mini statement
scenarios.then: the newest 10 are shown with date, description, amount, and balance

stories.summary: Get a statement for a date range
stories.story: As a retail customer, I want transactions between two dates, so that I can file my tax return.

lld.text: Paging of 50 rows. Opening balance from the day before the start date.

scenarios.name: Range within 12 months
scenarios.when: the customer asks for the statement
scenarios.then: all transactions of that period are shown with running balance

scenarios.name: Range too old
scenarios.when: the customer asks for the statement
scenarios.then: "Choose a date within the last 12 months" is shown

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want my statement as a password-protected PDF, so that I can send it to my loan officer.

lld.text: PDF/A with AES-256 owner and user passwords.

scenarios.name: Protected PDF
scenarios.then: a PDF opens only with the password NAME + DDMM

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want my statement by e-mail every month, so that I keep records without logging in.

lld.text: Runs at 02:00 on the 1st, in batches of 500 customers.

scenarios.name: Mailed on the 1st
scenarios.when: the month-end job runs on the 1st
scenarios.then: an e-mail with the protected PDF is sent

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to move money from Savings to Current, so that I can cover a payment.

lld.text: One CBS call posts debit and credit in the same transaction. No OTP needed.

scenarios.name: Instant transfer
scenarios.when: the customer moves INR 10,000 to Current
scenarios.then: both balances change at once and a reference number is shown

scenarios.name: Insufficient balance
scenarios.then: "Insufficient balance" is shown and nothing is posted

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to send money to a beneficiary instantly, so that the payee gets it at once.

lld.text: Status polling every 5 s for up to 60 s. A timeout moves the transfer to FAILED and starts a reversal check.

scenarios.name: IMPS success
scenarios.when: the customer sends INR 20,000 and confirms with OTP
scenarios.then: status is Success with an IMPS reference within 30 seconds

scenarios.name: Above IMPS limit
scenarios.then: "IMPS limit is INR 5,00,000" is shown

stories.summary: Send money by NEFT or RTGS
stories.story: As a business customer, I want to pay large amounts by NEFT or RTGS, so that I can pay suppliers.

lld.text: Mode chosen by the customer; amount below INR 2,00,000 offers NEFT only.

scenarios.name: RTGS minimum
scenarios.given: an amount of INR 1,50,000 with RTGS chosen
scenarios.then: "RTGS needs at least INR 2,00,000" is shown

stories.story: As a bank risk officer, I want third-party transfers capped per day, so that a stolen login cannot empty an account.

lld.text: Sum of successful and pending third-party transfers since midnight IST.

scenarios.name: Limit reached
scenarios.then: "Daily limit exceeded" is shown

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to add a payee with account number and IFSC, so that I can send money to them.

lld.text: Account number entered twice. Name check through IMPS penny-drop is a later story.

scenarios.name: Valid IFSC
scenarios.when: the customer adds the payee and confirms with OTP
scenarios.then: the payee is active with a cap of INR 50,000 for 24 hours

scenarios.name: Unknown IFSC
scenarios.then: "Unknown IFSC code" is shown

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to remove a payee I no longer use, so that my list stays short.

lld.text: Soft delete; kept 8 years for audit.

scenarios.name: Deleted
scenarios.given: a payee with no pending transfer
scenarios.then: it disappears from the list

stories.story: As a retail customer, I want to pay my electricity bill online, so that I avoid queues.

lld.text: Bill fetched from BBPS; payment debits the chosen account.

scenarios.name: Bill paid
scenarios.given: consumer number 123456789 with a bill of INR 2,340
scenarios.then: the biller confirms and a receipt is shown

stories.summary: Get an alert on every debit
stories.story: As a retail customer, I want an SMS and e-mail for every debit, so that I spot fraud early.

lld.text: Consumes CBS debit events from a queue; retries SMS 3 times.

scenarios.name: SMS within 60 s
scenarios.then: an SMS and e-mail with amount, last 4 digits, and balance arrive within 60 seconds
